description: This file contains functions for creating and configuring HTTP requests used in Kubernetes health probes, including URL formatting, header management, and user agent generation.

methods.name: NewProbeRequest
methods.description: Creates an HTTP GET request for probing, with default headers.

methods.name: NewRequestForHTTPGetAction
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP request based on a Kubernetes HTTPGetAction, container info, and pod IP.

methods.name: newProbeRequest
methods.description: Helper to create an HTTP request with headers and user agent.

methods.name: userAgent
methods.description: Generates a user agent string based on purpose and Kubernetes version.

methods.name: formatURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL from scheme, host, port, and path.

methods.name: v1HeaderToHTTPHeader
methods.description: Converts Kubernetes HTTPHeader list to standard HTTP headers.
